unresolved_assumptions: The source DXF and declared cut intent represent authorized product requirements and acceptable kerf/dimensional outcomes.
Synthetic process, material, ventilation and beam-control declarations apply to an actual reviewed machine/site.

simulation.reason: No reviewed process settings or final controller output exists; applicable process/output verification and simulation disposition remain undecided.
required_checks: Define process/path verification and independent beam and emission review with a qualified operator.

human_review.action: Confirm the source, units/scale, dimensions and cut intent; identify material grade/composition and thickness; provide applicable machine/process settings evidence, separate beam and process-emission/site reviews, and verify final output before approval.
human_review.reviewer_role: Design owner and qualified laser/material/site reviewer

verification.summary: Revision-A source inventory and selected DXF hashes match; test authority is not authenticated manufacturing intent or permission.
Restricted DXF review found three closed contours and matching 60 x 40 dimensions; cut intent, kerf and receiver interpretation remain unverified.
Process identities match synthetic profiles but settings are empty and machine/material lifecycles are unverified.
No applicable machine/site beam-safety review is supplied; no beam activation is permitted.
Known ventilation and unsafe-material-not-indicated labels are not material-composition or site/emission evidence.
No final controller output or process-specific output verification is supplied.
